title: New Hampshire (NH) Counties
text:
New Hampshire (NH) Counties

FIPS codes for New Hampshire.

FIPS State Code: 33

Enter the U.S. country code (01) followed by the state and county code.

For example, for Grafton County, enter 
01-33009.

| 003 | Carroll |
